requirements.quote: 1. THESE CONTRACT DOCUMENTS ARE SCHEMATIC IN NATURE AND REPRESENT A COMPLETED PROJECT. MINOR MODIFICATIONS OF WORK SHALL BE PROVIDED BY THE CONTRACTOR TO COMPLY WITH PROJECT REQUIREMENTS AND TO INSTALL A WORKING SYSTEM.
requirements.text: Contractor must provide minor modifications to comply with project requirements and install a working system.

requirements.quote: 2. THE CONTRACT SPECIFICATIONS FOR THIS PROJECT ARE AN INTEGRAL PART OF THESE CONTRACT DOCUMENTS AND SHALL BE CONSIDERED PART OF AND COMPLIMENTARY TO THE INFORMATION IN THESE CONTRACT DRAWINGS.
requirements.text: Contract specifications are integral and complementary to contract drawings.

requirements.quote: 3. ALL REFERENCES TO THE CONTRACTOR REFERS TO THE CONTRACTOR OR CONTRACTORS RESPONSIBLE FOR ANY AND ALL WORK SHOWN ON THESE ELECTRICAL CONTRACT DOCUMENTS.
requirements.text: Contractor is responsible for all work shown on electrical contract documents.

requirements.quote: 4. ALL MATERIAL AND EQUIPMENT SHALL BE LISTED AS APPROPRIATE FOR THE APPLICATION.
requirements.text: Materials and equipment must be listed as appropriate for their application.

requirements.quote: 5. ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR SHALL FIELD VERIFY ALL EXISTING CONDITIONS AND DIMENSIONS PRIOR TO COMMENCEMENT OF ANY WORK OR SHOP FABRICATION.
requirements.text: Electrical contractor must verify existing conditions and dimensions before starting work.

requirements.quote: 6. COORDINATE THE WORK ON THESE DRAWINGS WITH THE WORK OF ALL OTHER DRAWINGS AND CONTRACTS IN THE AFFECTED AND/OR ADJACENT AREAS.
requirements.text: Coordinate work with other drawings and contracts in affected areas.

requirements.quote: 7. PROVIDE GROUNDING & BONDING IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE NATIONAL ELECTRICAL CODE AND THE CONTRACT DOCUMENTS.
requirements.text: Provide grounding and bonding per National Electrical Code and contract documents.

requirements.quote: 8. PROVIDE ELECTRICAL CONNECTION FOR EVERY FIXTURE, ITEM OR ANY EQUIPMENT REQUIRING ANY ELECTRICAL CONNECTION WHICH IS SHOWN ON ANY CONTRACT DRAWING OR NOTED IN ANY TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION.
requirements.text: Provide electrical connections for all fixtures and equipment requiring them.

requirements.quote: 9. EXISTING CIRCUITS, AND DEVICES, WHICH ARE PRESENT OR PASS THROUGH AFFECTED AREAS, SHALL BE MAINTAINED OPERATIONAL, AS REQUIRED, AND AS DIRECTED.
requirements.text: Maintain operational status of existing circuits and devices in affected areas.

requirements.quote: 10. THE CONTRACTOR IS RESPONSIBLE FOR ANY EQUIPMENT OR WORK THAT MAY BE REQUIRED TO BE TEMPORARILY DISCONNECTED, REMOVED AND/OR RELOCATED AS PART OF THE CONTRACTORS WORK OR THE WORK OF OTHER TRADES.
requirements.text: Contractor must handle temporary disconnection, removal, or relocation of equipment.

requirements.quote: 11. ALL EQUIPMENT SHALL BE INSTALLED IN A NEAT AND WORKMAN LIKE MANNER, RECTILINEAR TO BUILDING STRUCTURE.
requirements.text: Install equipment neatly and aligned with building structure.

requirements.quote: 12. ALL RACEWAYS THROUGH BUILDING EXPANSION JOINTS SHALL BE EQUIPPED WITH EXPANSION FITTINGS.
requirements.text: Equip raceways through expansion joints with expansion fittings.

requirements.quote: 13. ALL CUTTING AND PATCHING OF BUILDING COMPONENTS REQUIRED TO ACCOMMODATE THE WORK OF THIS CONTRACT SHALL BE THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE CONTRACTOR.
requirements.text: Contractor is responsible for cutting and patching building components.

requirements.quote: 14. ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE NECESSARY SUPPORT FRAMING, STIFFENERS, BRACING, AND HANGERS TO ENSURE A COMPLETE AND DURABLE SYSTEM.
requirements.text: Provide support framing, stiffeners, bracing, and hangers for durability.

requirements.quote: 15. 120/277V, 20A CIRCUITS SHALL BE FED WITH #12AWG CONDUCTORS AND A #12AWG GROUND MINIMUM, UNLESS STATED OTHERWISE.
requirements.text: Use #12AWG conductors and ground for 120/277V, 20A circuits unless stated otherwise.

requirements.quote: 16. NOT ALL SYMBOLS AND NOT ALL NOTES ARE USED ON THESE CONTRACT DRAWINGS.
requirements.text: Not all symbols and notes are used in the contract drawings.

requirements.quote: 17. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL MAINTAIN RECORD DRAWINGS ON SITE SHOWING CHANGES MADE DUE TO FIELD CONDITIONS OR ENGINEER APPROVED CHANGES.
requirements.text: Maintain record drawings on site showing field or engineer-approved changes.

requirements.quote: 18. REMOVAL NOTES: A. REMOVE ALL EXISTING ELECTRICAL ITEMS SHOWN ON THE REMOVAL DRAWINGS UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
requirements.text: Remove all existing electrical items shown on removal drawings unless noted otherwise.
